keepsakes.name: Pocket Flashlight
keepsakes.desc: At the end of every Scuffle, recover 6 Courage.

keepsakes.name: Chalk Stub
keepsakes.desc: Unsurveyed rooms on the blueprint show what they really are.

keepsakes.name: Black Ribbon
keepsakes.desc: Once each Scuffle, when an enemy hides or leaves the battlefield, your Attack Tricks deal 3 more damage for the rest of the fight.

keepsakes.name: Lucky Button
keepsakes.desc: Rare Trick rewards appear noticeably more often.

keepsakes.name: Brass Bookmark
keepsakes.desc: The first time each Scuffle one of your Tricks is marked or made to cost more, draw 1 Trick.

keepsakes.name: The Empty Goblet
keepsakes.desc: The first time each Scuffle you lose Courage to one of your own effects, gain 8 Guard.

keepsakes.name: Bowl With Your Name On It
keepsakes.desc: Recover 3 Courage at the start of every Scuffle.

keepsakes.name: House Slippers
keepsakes.desc: The first attack against you each Scuffle deals 3 less damage.

keepsakes.name: Tin of Sardines
keepsakes.desc: Whenever an enemy is defeated, recover 3 Courage. Something always comes to eat.

keepsakes.name: Bent Garden Fork
keepsakes.desc: The first time each Scuffle an enemy recovers Courage, deal 3 damage to it.

keepsakes.name: Butterfly Net
keepsakes.desc: Every 10th Trick you play in a Scuffle, draw 2.

keepsakes.name: Lamplighter's Wick
keepsakes.desc: Your first Trick each turn costs 1 less. You start every Scuffle with 5 fewer Courage.

keepsakes.name: Welcome Mat
keepsakes.desc: Gain 4 Guard at the start of every Scuffle.

keepsakes.name: Nightlight
keepsakes.desc: Attacks that would deal 5 or less damage to you deal 1 instead.

keepsakes.name: Brass Service Bell
keepsakes.desc: The first time each Scuffle you end a turn with 0 Nerve, draw 1 extra Trick next turn.

keepsakes.name: Bent Sickle
keepsakes.desc: Once each turn, when you defeat something with 10 or more damage to spare, gain 4 Guard and draw 1.

keepsakes.name: Hollow Birdcage
keepsakes.desc: Whenever an enemy is defeated, draw 1 Trick and gain 4 Guard.

keepsakes.name: Bathhouse Slippers
keepsakes.desc: Your first Trick each turn ignores any increase to its Nerve cost.

hazards.name: Fresh Paw Prints
hazards.rule: A trail runs through here. Every room inside the marked area also yields a Clue for your Kid.

hazards.name: The Floor Sags
hazards.rule: Entering any room inside the marked area costs 3 Courage. The boards remember your weight.

hazards.name: Long Shadows
hazards.rule: Guard you gain is halved while you are inside the marked area. Your defence is worth less in the dark.

meta.name: The Heart of the House
meta.form: Impossible interior · a plan folded into an organ
